description: This file defines an interface for a publish-subscribe factory pattern, providing methods to start distributed pub and sub supervisors.

classes.name: PubSubFactory
classes.description: Interface defining methods to start distributed pub and sub components.

methods.name: startDistributedPub
methods.description: Creates and returns access to a distributed publication, fails if called a second time in the same actor system.

methods.name: startDistributedSub
methods.description: Creates and returns access to a distributed subscription, fails if called a second time in the same actor system.
